schema.name: idx_state_list_key_id
schema.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_state_list_key_id ON state_list(key, id)

schema.name: state_hash
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE state_hash (key TEXT NOT NULL, field TEXT NOT NULL, value BLOB NOT NULL, expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (key, field))

schema.name: state_kv
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE state_kv (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value BLOB NOT NULL, expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

schema.name: state_list
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE state_list (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, key TEXT NOT NULL, value BLOB NOT NULL, expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

schema.name: state_zset
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE state_zset (key TEXT NOT NULL, member TEXT NOT NULL, score REAL NOT NULL, expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (key, member))
